questions.question: When should you use an interface?
questions.title: Types And Interfaces
questions.direct_answer: Use an interface at a boundary where multiple implementations or a test double are useful; keep it small and defined by the consumer’s needs.

interviewer_intent.testing: Whether you understand Types And Interfaces beyond memorized syntax.
interviewer_intent.common_mistake: Giving a definition without explaining a practical trade-off.
interviewer_intent.to_stand_out: Connect the concept to a small production example and state its complexity or failure mode.

sections.title: Interview answer
sections.content: Use an interface at a boundary where multiple implementations or a test double are useful; keep it small and defined by the consumer’s needs. In a real project, I would use it when it fits the situation and mention one edge case.
